page_title: CLE 0-1 MET | Clermont v Metz 27/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' Ismael Traore (Metz) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
90+7' Ismael Traore (Metz) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90+5' Clermont can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+5' Clermont take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+1' Pascal Gastien is forced to make a change. Muhammed Cham is unable to continue due to injury, Jeremie Bela (Clermont) comes on.
90+1' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) picks up an injury.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Metz comes to nothing.
88' The resulting corner, taken by Aiman Maurer (Clermont), comes to nothing.
86' Laszlo Boloni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Joseph Nduquidi (Metz) replacing Cheikh Sabaly.
86' The referee allows time for a substitution. Georges Mikautadze will be replaced by Ibou Sane (Metz).
85' Clermont fail to score from a corner as Alexandre Oukidja (Metz) leaps to collect the ball.
83' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Gael Angoula had an easy-decision to make.
82' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the left post.
79' Pascal Gastien prepares a substitution. Florent Ogier is replaced by Cheick Oumar Konate (Clermont).
79' That's the end of the game for Mehdi Zeffane, who is replaced by Bilal Boutobba (Clermont).
78' Matthieu Udol (Metz) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
77' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
73' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
71' We are about to witness a substitution. Habib Maiga (Metz) is replacing Simon Elisor.
69' 0 - 1 GOAL! Georges Mikautadze (Metz) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 0:1.
68' Pascal Gastien has decided to make a change. Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) replaces Komnen Andric.
68' Substitution. Aiman Maurer (Clermont) in, Jim Allevinah out.
66' The game is interrupted now, Johan Gastien (Clermont) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
66' Neto Borges (Clermont) is able to continue to play.
63' Neto Borges (Clermont) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
61' Komnen Andric (Clermont) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but his shot missed the target close to the right post.
59' Matthieu Udol (Metz) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
59' Kevin N'Doram (Metz) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
58' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Muhammed Cham (Clermont) was quite harsh and Gael Angoula didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

56' Mory Diaw makes a brilliant save! Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
54' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Muhammed Cham (Clermont). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
51' The resulting set piece from Metz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
49' Jim Allevinah (Clermont) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
49' Fali Cande (Metz) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
48' Looks like Jim Allevinah (Clermont) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
47' Fali Cande (Metz) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
46' Referee Gael Angoula blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Matthieu Udol (Metz) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
45+2' Neto Borges (Clermont) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
43' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) takes a mid-range free kick and looks to threaten the goalkeeper, but the ball goes way wide of the left post.
42' Fali Cande (Metz) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Gael Angoula blows for a foul.
40' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Mory Diaw makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!

39' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
36' Clermont are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
33' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
29' Florent Ogier (Clermont) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the left post.
28' Johan Gastien (Clermont) steps up to send the ball in.
27' Johan Gastien (Clermont) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
25' Komnen Andric (Clermont) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
24' Fali Cande (Metz) was too forceful with his tackle and Gael Angoula interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
22' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) beautifully controls a cross from the wing inside the box, but he fails to test the keeper and sends his shot miles past the right post.
21' Simon Elisor (Metz) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
19' The Clermont players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
15' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
11' Laszlo Boloni is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Maxime Colin (Metz) suffers an injury and Koffi Kouao comes on.
7' The resulting corner from Muhammed Cham (Clermont) is cleared.
7' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Muhammed Cham (Clermont), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
7' Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.
6' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) launches a cross from the corner, but Alexandre Oukidja is alert to thwart the effort.
5' My Gran could have done better! Simon Elisor (Metz) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Clermont will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Gael Angoula.
